Name: Anna Lollipop - Custom NPC UPDATE 2.0.0
Author: AnnasCreator
Description:
[center][u][font=Arial][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/1t8RYQc9/Anna-Multi-Portraits1.png[/img]
[/b][/font][/u]
[b][size=5][font=Arial]There's a new girl in town.[/font][/size][/b]
Anna showed up in Pelican Town the way she does most things, with zero plan and complete confidence that it would work out. She came from the Gallia Continents, a place with its own culture, language, and a level of corruption that eventually made leaving feel less like running away and more like survival. She caught the first plane out. It stopped here.

She's staying with Haley for now.

You'll find her around town being dramatic over Pierre's lollipop stock, complaining loudly about the summer heat, and standing outside in the snow in the middle of winter having a fun time. She's warm, chaotic, loyal to the people she lets into her circle, and privately carrying more than she lets on.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/B61cDNQ2/Anna-Features.png[/img]

[u][font=Arial][b]﻿This mod is currently under development.[/b][/font][/u][font=Arial] Anna's current features are:[/font]

[list]
[*][b]Full seasonal dialogue[/b] — unique lines for every day of the week across all four seasons, plus weather-specific and heart-level-gated dialogue that shows her character deepening over time.[/*]
[*][b]5 heart events[/b] — a complete story arc from first meeting to a moment of true honesty, including a branching 8-heart event with a good and bad ending.[/*]
[*][b]Marriage content[/b] — morning lines, evening lines, rainy day dialogue, seasonal married lines, post-kiss reactions, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Custom portrait sheet[/b] — 9 expressions including her signature lollipop portrait.[/*]
[*][b]French dialogue sprinkled throughout[/b] — Anna slips into Gallican (French) when she's emotional, frustrated, or just not thinking about it.[/*]
[*][b]Alternate appearance's add-on[/b] — Two optional Alternate appearance mod available separately ([i]Gallia Ball Dance and You Seem Pretty in Love[/i]) toggleable via GMCM.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=#e06666]SMAPI[/color][/url][/center]
[center]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#e06666]Content Patcher[/color][/url]

[b][size=3]Alternate Appearances Req:[/size][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e06666]GMCM[/color][/url]

[b][size=6]UPDATE[/size][/b]
[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZKbQ4p9w/Anna2-0-0fet.png[/img]

[/b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/7hxKPrL7/Anna-File-House.png[/img]
Anna now has a house! Beginning year 1, Anna will live with Haley, as she has been. Next to Pierre's shop, there will be a construction site. That's where her house will be constructed. Once the player hits year 2, Anna's house will have been fully built.

- Added Anna's House for year 2
- Added construction site for year 1
- Fully custom interior for Anna's house
- Added a 6 heart move in event once year 2 hits
- Fixed Alternate Appearances compatibility
- MAY BREAK ANNA FROM SAVES WITH PREVIOUS VERSION[/center]
[center]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/QtLqYX1T/Anna-Heart.png[/img]
